sloka: सुमाली वरलब्धांस्तु ज्ञात्वा चैतान्निशाचरान् ।उदतिष्ठद्भयं त्यक्त्वा सानुगः स रसातलात् ।। ७.११.१ ॥
transliteration: sumālī varalabdhāṁstu jñātvā caitānniśācarān ।udatiṣṭhadbhayaṁ tyaktvā sānugaḥ sa rasātalāt ।। 7.11.1 ॥

translations.english: Sumali, having learned that these night-wanderers had obtained boons, rose up from Rasatala with his followers, abandoning all fear.
